behavior: Read Market Segments, Subsegment Tags, Product Models, Distribution Models, Data Input Layers, Company Overrides, and keyword rules from Drive/repo.
Lowercase, trim, remove punctuation/corporate suffixes for matching.
If company exists in Company Overrides, assign all taxonomy fields from override.
If no override, apply deterministic rules by dimension. Only approved codes accepted.
If deterministic mapping is weak, ask LLM to recommend only among approved codes and record suggestion/basis.
If primary_market_segment is missing or OTHER_REVIEW, hard stop and write a segment review packet.
Dashboard groups by primary_market_segment and allows filters by subsegment/product/distribution/data tags.
